clips.title: The story
paras: Devourer of Souls is an introductory step in a Forsaken warlock's journey to summon and bind a succubus. Directed by Carendin Halgar in the Undercity's Temple of the Damned, the practitioner must confer with his assistant, Godrick Farsan, to learn how to lure such a creature from the Twisting Nether. The ritual demands an irresistible stimulus: the hearts of pure and loving mortals.

Carendin Halgar teaches that a succubus cannot simply be pulled across the threshold on command; it must be enticed. Driven by an insatiable hunger to ruin virtue and consume mortal essence, the demon requires a specific lure. The warlock's strategy relies on exploiting this singular desire by offering up the hearts of genuinely virtuous, loving men as bait. Halgar directs his acolytes to Godrick Farsan, who knows where such rare quarry can be harvested.

Located deeper within the Temple of the Damned, Godrick Farsan assists Carendin with the practical preparations of demonic binding. Though Farsan has lost his physical eyesight, he claims his condition grants him a profound second sight—allowing him to perceive underlying spiritual currents and far-off souls with uncanny clarity. He serves as the guide for locating the pure hearts necessary to draw the demon forth.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A succubus is a devourer of souls, destroyer of hearts, tempter of men. A creature of profound evil and of singular mind.
It cannot be brought into our world without a stimulus.

Thus we use its own strength against it. With the hearts of good men, pure men, loving men, the succubus will be unable to resist, and will cross into our world. Then you can dominate it, and make it your own.
Speak with my assistant, Godrick Farsan, within the Temple. He will help you find your bait.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You were sent by Carendin? Friend, then.
Do not think light of me because my sight is gone. I see things that lie behind now, with clarity I had never known. What I once thought a curse, is now a boon.
